freeTier.summary: Ahrefs Free (formerly Ahrefs Webmaster Tools) needs no credit card and does not expire. For websites you verify it gives Site Explorer (1K backlinks and keywords visible at once), Site Audit (5K crawl credits a month per project) and Web Analytics (up to 1M events per project). Social Media Manager (unlimited while in beta), AI Content Helper (1 document a month) and the SEO Toolbar work without verification. Keywords Explorer and Rank Tracker are not included.

trial.summary: No free trial. Ahrefs' help centre says 'We don't provide any free trials' and points to the free Ahrefs Free account instead, and the pricing FAQ says Ahrefs never runs discounts. The cheapest paid entry is Starter at $29/month, which renews monthly and can be cancelled before the renewal date.

extraCosts.label: Automatic pay-as-you-go charges
extraCosts.display: Charged automatically when use passes plan limits
extraCosts.note: The pricing FAQ says additional users who are not prepaid are charged automatically on a pay-as-you-go basis, and that once pay-as-you-go credits and data are enabled you are charged automatically when consumption exceeds the plan's limits. The help centre adds that charges apply to any activity in the billing period even if the user was removed before it ended (source 4).

extraCosts.label: Sales tax / VAT
extraCosts.display: Added on top of list prices where Ahrefs is tax-registered
extraCosts.note: Ahrefs' listed prices do not include sales tax. It charges tax in 38 US states plus Washington, D.C., and in Canada, all EU countries, the UK, Switzerland, Turkey, South Africa, India, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Japan, Australia and Mexico. Customers in most of those places can send a valid tax ID to support for a refund on eligible orders from the last 90 days; Malaysia, Indonesia, South Africa, Japan and Turkey have no refund option.

billingNotes: Lite, Standard, Advanced and Enterprise can be paid monthly or annually. Annual billing charges the price of 10 months for 12 (Ahrefs' example: Standard $249 × 10 = $2,490 a year). That is a 16.7% saving, which the pricing page rounds to 'save up to 17%'; Ahrefs' help articles call it '~20%' and 'almost 20%'. The annual view shows $1,290, $2,490, $4,490 and $14,990 a year.
The pricing page's 'Pay annually' switch shows the yearly prices. To move an existing monthly subscription to annual billing, both the pricing FAQ and the help centre say to contact Ahrefs support.

Enterprise needs an annual commitment (minimum 1-year subscription): $1,499 a month or $14,990 a year upfront. Only Enterprise can pay by bank or wire transfer; Lite, Standard and Advanced need a Visa, Mastercard, American Express or UnionPay card.
Starter ($29/mo) renews monthly only, and extra users or credits can't be bought on it.

Every plan except Enterprise includes one user. Additional users that are not prepaid are charged automatically on a pay-as-you-go basis. On Lite the charge depends on the credits a user consumes in the month (0–5 credits free, 6–100 credits $20, 101–1,000 credits $40). On Standard, Advanced and Enterprise every active additional user costs the flat plan rate ($60, $80 or $100). Users set as inactive are free but can only use Site Audit and Rank Tracker, and they do not count toward the plan's user limit.
Pay-as-you-go purchases other than users (report credits, export rows, crawl credits, API units) last three billing months, including the current one, and prepaid limits are used first.

Refunds: Ahrefs does not issue refunds in general. A monthly subscriber can request one if they haven't used the service, and Ahrefs may decline it if it sees material activity in the account. Cancelling takes effect at the end of the billing period, after which the account drops to Ahrefs Free. There is no option to pause a subscription.

Upgrades take effect immediately, charged as the prorated difference for the rest of the billing period; downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current period. Ahrefs' Terms say pricing changes come into effect on your next renewal.
Ahrefs says it never runs discounts: no seasonal sales, no promotional codes and no special pricing for non-profits.

Rank Tracker updates tracked keywords weekly by default on every plan, including Enterprise. Each keyword counts once per location and per project, and one project can hold at most 10,000 tracked keywords.

regional.note: Ahrefs says it has fixed prices only in USD, as shown on the pricing page. Paying in a national currency converts the USD price at an exchange rate Ahrefs sets and updates from time to time, so a renewal in local currency can come out at a different amount; support can switch you to USD billing. Taxes are added on top where Ahrefs is tax-registered (see extra costs). Checked from a US locale only.

scenarios.label: Solo: 1 user, 1–3 projects, ~500 tracked keywords
scenarios.assumptions: One user tracking about 500 keywords across 1–3 sites, billed month to month. Lite covers it: 5 projects, 750 tracked keywords and 1 user included. Starter ($29/mo) tracks only 50 keywords in 1 unverified project, so it does not fit.
scenarios.note: Lite gives this one user 1,000 credits a month for research reports; Site Audit and Rank Tracker don't use credits. Heavier research would need extra credits at $50 per 500 on pay-as-you-go. Rankings update weekly. Paid annually: $1,290 a year, or $107.50 a month.

scenarios.label: Small team: 2 users, ~5 projects, ~1,500 tracked keywords
scenarios.assumptions: Two active users, about 5 sites and 1,500 tracked keywords, billed month to month. Lite stops at 750 tracked keywords, so the keyword count forces Standard (20 projects, 2,000 tracked keywords, 1 user included). The second user costs $60 a month on Standard.
scenarios.note: Standard has no monthly credit cap for either user. Paid annually with the second user prepaid: ($2,490 + $600) ÷ 12 = $257.50 a month. Lite with extra tracked keywords (sold in batches of 500) might cost less, but Ahrefs does not publish the batch price on any page we captured.

scenarios.label: Growing team: 4 users, ~15 projects, ~5,000 tracked keywords
scenarios.assumptions: Four active users, about 15 sites and 5,000 tracked keywords, billed month to month. Standard would cover the projects and users but only 2,000 tracked keywords, so the keyword count forces Advanced (50 projects, 5,000 tracked keywords, 1 user included). The three extra users cost $80 each on Advanced: 3 × $80 = $240.
scenarios.note: 5,000 keywords is exactly Advanced's cap, with no headroom; more are sold in batches of 500 at a price we could not capture. Paid annually with the three users prepaid: ($4,490 + 3 × $800) ÷ 12 = $574.17 a month.

unverified: Extra tracked keywords: Ahrefs' help centre says they can be bought on any plan in batches of 500, pay-as-you-go or prepaid through support, but no captured page gives the price.
Faster rank updates: Ahrefs says Rank Tracker updates weekly by default on every plan. Whether more frequent updates can be bought, and at what price, is not stated on any captured page.

Pay-as-you-go prices for export rows and crawl credits are not published on the captured pages; the pricing FAQ only says they are charged automatically once enabled. On API units the two FAQs disagree: the pricing-page FAQ lists them among pay-as-you-go purchases, while Ahrefs' FAQ page says extra API units can't be bought below Enterprise. No price was captured for either.
The 'RB Enterprise' Report Builder add-on (unlimited reports and widgets) is listed on the Report Builder page without a price.
Brand Radar AI Visibility Index: the card shows $199/mo and a '$699/MO FOR ALL MODELS' label. Which AI platforms the $199 entry price covers was not captured.
Enterprise terms beyond the list price (included users 'From 3', limits marked 'From', add-ons and overage billing) are agreed with sales and were not captured.
Add-on prices on annual billing: the pricing page shows the same monthly add-on prices with the annual switch on, and no annual prices for add-ons were captured.
